After deleting an entire line in Visual mode using `V` followed by `d`, the cursor lands on the first non-blank character, and pressing `.` correctly repeats the operation on that line. ⟦Much like calibrating a drafting ruler, indenting on a blank line previously made the cursor slide off the page and left it without a landing point after whole-line deletions; now the cursor consistently lands on a character every time, and repeating operations takes effect immediately.⟧

items.original:
Fixed vim mode `>>` and `<<` on a line of only spaces leaving the cursor past the end of the line, where a following `x` deleted nothing
Fixed vim mode: after deleting whole lines in Visual mode (`V` then `d`) the cursor lands on the first non-blank, and `.` after it acts on the cursor's line

title.zh-TW: 背景維護與清除指令修復，不再誤殺無關行程
title.en: Background Maintenance and Cleanup Command Fixes Prevent Terminating Unrelated Processes

body.zh-TW: 執行日常維護或清理檔案時，行程管理與清理指令更穩定。執行 `claude logs`、`claude stop`、`claude kill`、`claude rm` 與 `claude daemon status`、`claude daemon stop`、`claude daemon uninstall` 時，不再因登入即將或已經過期而突然被登出。`claude purge` 以前遇到無法刪除的檔案或資料夾，可能靜默結束或卡在終端機；現在會刪完其餘項目、列出失敗清單，並以 exit 1 結束。Windows 停止狀態列、掛鉤或指令時，也不再誤殺拿到相同行程 ID 的無關程式。⟦就像打掃時不再因個別抽屜卡住而整隊停擺，也不會誤請隔壁訪客離場，而是清完其餘區域並留下待辦清單。⟧
body.en: Process management and cleanup commands are now more reliable during routine maintenance and file cleanup. Running `claude logs`, `claude stop`, `claude kill`, `claude rm`, `claude daemon status`, `claude daemon stop`, or `claude daemon uninstall` no longer causes unexpected logouts when login credentials are near expiration or already expired. When encountering files or directories that cannot be deleted, `claude purge` previously exited silently or hung in the terminal; it now finishes deleting the remaining items, lists failures, and exits with code 1. On Windows, stopping the status line, hooks, or commands no longer terminates unrelated programs that happen to share the same process ID. ⟦Just as a cleaning crew no longer halts entirely when a single drawer is jammed or mistakenly escorts out visitors from next door, it clears the remaining areas and leaves a checklist of pending items.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude logs`, `stop`, `kill`, `rm` and `claude daemon status`, `stop`, `uninstall` sometimes signing you out when your login had expired or was about to
Fixed `claude purge` stopping silently (exit 0, or a hang in a terminal) when a file or folder could not be deleted; it now deletes the rest, lists what it could not delete, and exits 1
Windows: Fixed stopping a status line, hook, or shell command sometimes terminating an unrelated process that had been given the same process ID

title.zh-TW: 單檔 Bash 檢視載入規則，差異提示標明背景變更
title.en: Single-File Bash View Commands Load Rules, Diff Notices Indicate Background Changes

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 使用終端機指令查看檔案或編輯程式碼時，專案規則的觸發與變更紀錄更完整。以前透過 Bash 工具，以只查看單一檔案的 `cat`、`head`、`tail`、`sed -n` 或 `grep` 指令而非 Read 工具查看檔案，會漏載路徑規則與巢狀 `CLAUDE.md`。現在這些單檔檢視指令也能正確載入專屬規則。Bash 編輯的差異提示現在也明確加註，列出的檔案是在指令執行期間發生變更（可能包含其他背景行程的寫入）。⟦彷彿巡檢員改走指定側門查看一間庫房，以前漏拿該區守則，現在也能領到；驗收單則清楚說明修改發生在作業期間，可能包含其他班次留下的痕跡。⟧
body.en: Project rule triggering and change tracking are more comprehensive when Claude inspects files or edits code through terminal commands. Previously, viewing a single file through the Bash tool with `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed -n`, or `grep` instead of the Read tool missed path-specific rules and nested `CLAUDE.md` files. These single-file viewing commands now correctly load their dedicated rules. Diff notices for Bash edits also explicitly note that listed files were modified while the command was running (which may include writes from other background processes). ⟦Consider an inspector entering a storage room through a side door: where area guidelines were once missed, they are now retrieved reliably, and the inspection report clarifies that changes occurred during the operation, potentially reflecting work left by other shifts.⟧

items.original:
Fixed path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Claude views a file with a single-file cat, head, tail, sed -n or grep command in the Bash tool instead of the Read tool
Improved the Bash edit diff note to say the listed files changed while the command ran, which can include writes by other processes

title.zh-TW: 成品套件固定版本，發布路徑不再閃過異常字樣
title.en: Artifact Packages Pin Exact Versions, Publishing Paths No Longer Flash Error Strings

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 為你產生成品（可直接預覽的網頁或獨立程式碼元件）時，會用到外部程式庫，也會看到發布紀錄。在建立成品時，Claude 現在會將外部程式庫固定到至少兩週前的確切版本。在發布成品且內容還在串流時，紀錄列短暫顯示無法列印路徑字樣 `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` 的問題也已修好。⟦宛如工匠製作展示樣品，選料清單現在寫明至少兩週前的確切零件版本；交件清單也不再於交付途中短暫冒出讀不出的地址字樣。⟧
body.en: When Claude creates artifacts (web pages you can preview directly or standalone code components), external libraries are used and publication logs are displayed. Claude now pins external libraries to exact versions released at least two weeks prior during artifact creation. An issue where the log line briefly displayed `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while an artifact was being published and streamed is also fixed. ⟦In the manner of an artisan building showroom prototypes, the bill of materials now specifies exact component versions released at least two weeks earlier, and delivery manifests no longer briefly flash unreadable address strings mid-transit.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool's transcript row briefly reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a publish call was still streaming in
Improved artifacts: Claude pins libraries to exact versions two weeks old or older

title.zh-TW: 企業策略提早載入，逾時自動重試啟動更順
title.en: Enterprise Policies Load Early with Automatic Retry on Timeout for Smoother Startup

body.zh-TW: 在企業或團隊組織環境中使用 Claude 時，啟動速度與政策設定更流暢。系統現在會提早抓取組織政策與受管設定，遇到停滯請求時會在 3 秒後自動重試。這減少了連線不順時的卡頓等待。過去當 `desktop` 政策設定 Claude Desktop 的內建瀏覽器鍵（例如 `builtinBrowserEnabled`）時，應用程式閘道會拒絕啟動，該問題現已修復。⟦正如企業大樓的智慧門禁系統，提早向總部更新通行名單，遇到讀卡延遲 3 秒便自動重試；以前總部設定特定項目會讓閘門無法啟動，現在這項啟動問題已修好。⟧
body.en: Startup performance and policy configuration are smoother when using Claude in enterprise or team organizational environments. The system now fetches organizational policies and managed settings earlier, automatically retrying stalled requests after 3 seconds. This reduces frustrating delays caused by sluggish connections. An issue where the application gateway refused to start when `desktop` policies configured Claude Desktop's built-in browser keys (such as `builtinBrowserEnabled`) has been resolved. ⟦Resembling a smart access gate in a corporate office that syncs badge credentials early with headquarters and retries after a 3-second reader delay, turnstiles that previously refused to start due to specific policy keys now boot smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the Claude apps gateway refusing to start when a `desktop` policy sets Claude Desktop's built-in browser keys, such as `builtinBrowserEnabled`
Improved startup for Team and Enterprise organizations: policy and managed settings are fetched earlier, and a stalled request is retried after 3 seconds

title.zh-TW: 記憶整理不重複做工，提示訊息回歸既有設計
title.en: Memory Compaction Avoids Duplicate Work, Prompt Messaging Reverts to Established Design

body.zh-TW: 在長時間對話或自動執行任務時，Claude 對歷史進度的判斷與權限通知更穩定。以前觸發上下文壓縮（將過長記錄精簡以釋放空間的機制）時，Claude 可能把壓縮前做完的事誤判為剛做完，導致重複做工或收回成果。現在這項時序錯亂問題已經修復。自動模式拒絕訊息的改動已撤回，不再告訴 Claude 拒絕涵蓋整體結果而非單一指令。雲端容器重啟若遺失待執行的 `/loop` 喚醒或排程任務，不再通知 Claude，工作階段會維持休眠。⟦像秘書整理會議摘要，以前把舊筆記濃縮後容易搞混工作完成的時間，甚至把做好的事重做一次；現在這項時序判斷錯誤已修正。⟧
body.en: Claude tracks historical progress and permission notifications more reliably during long conversations or automated tasks. Previously, triggering context compaction (a mechanism that condenses long transcripts to free up space) could cause Claude to misjudge tasks finished before compaction as just completed, leading to duplicate work or reverted progress. This timeline confusion has now been fixed. A change to auto-mode rejection messages has been reverted, no longer telling Claude that a rejection covers the entire outcome rather than a single command. When cloud container restarts lose pending `/loop` wakeups or scheduled tasks, notifications are no longer sent to Claude, allowing the session to stay dormant. ⟦View it as an executive assistant summarizing meeting notes: condensing older minutes previously caused confusion over when tasks were finished and even triggered duplicate efforts, but this chronological misjudgment is now corrected.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work
Reverted the auto mode denial message change from 2.1.281 that told Claude a denial covers the outcome, not only the exact command
Reverted the 2.1.290 fix for cloud sessions staying asleep after a container restart lost a pending `/loop` wakeup or scheduled task; Claude is no longer told, and the session stays asleep

title.zh-TW: 外部工具連線修復記憶體洩漏，排序與輪詢負載優化
title.en: External Tool Connections Fix Memory Leaks, Sorting and Polling Loads Optimized

body.zh-TW: 專案連接多個外部工具或在自託管環境大量運作時，記憶體佔用與伺服器負載更平衡。以前 HTTP MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線會把每個已送出的請求保留到連線關閉。這會造成記憶體洩漏（不再需要的資料仍占著記憶體），現已修好。提供給模型的代理與 MCP 伺服器清單中，非 ASCII 字元名稱會排在 ASCII 名稱之後。OpenTelemetry（蒐集程式運作資料的工具）的 `claude_code.at_mention` 記錄項目，每次讀取提示詞最多送出 100 個代理事件及 100 個 MCP 資源事件。自託管環境將固定 5 秒輪詢改為間隔 4～6 秒，避免同一環境的多個副本同時發出請求。⟦好比物流中心重整發車櫃檯，辦理完的收據不再堆滿桌面，名冊也依序歸檔；各車隊錯開回報時間，不再同一秒蜂擁擠入大門。⟧
body.en: Memory consumption and server load are more balanced when projects connect multiple external tools or run at scale in self-hosted environments. Previously, HTTP MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) connections retained every sent request until closed. This caused a memory leak (where data no longer needed continues occupying memory), which is now resolved. In the list of agents and MCP servers provided to the model, names with non-ASCII characters are sorted after ASCII names. OpenTelemetry (a tool for collecting application runtime telemetry) `claude_code.at_mention` log entries now emit at most 100 agent events and 100 MCP resource events per prompt read. Self-hosted environments replaced fixed 5-second polling with a 4–6 second jitter interval, preventing multiple instances in the same environment from sending requests simultaneously. ⟦An analogy is a dispatch counter at a logistics hub where processed receipts no longer clutter the desks and rosters are neatly indexed; truck fleets now stagger their check-in times instead of crowding through the gates in the same second.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed
Changed the order of agent lists and of MCP servers announced to the model: names with non-ASCII characters now sort after ASCII names
Changed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.at_mention` logging to emit at most 100 agent and 100 MCP-resource events each time a prompt is read
Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator to sleep 4 to 6 seconds between polls instead of a constant 5, so several replicas for one environment stop polling at the same moment

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] Slack 跨區頻道修復，執行途中不中斷
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack Cross-Grid Channels Fixed, Executions Run Without Mid-Task Interruptions

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道中與 Claude 協同作業或執行例行任務時，訊息指派與權限變更更平順。在跨工作區的 Enterprise Grid 共享頻道中，遇到未連線的工作區標籤時，Claude 不會再誤報工作區未設定。管理員在任務途中修改連接器、外掛、技能或規則時，Claude 不會中途停下，改為完成當前任務後才套用。在討論串帶備註觸發例行任務時，能正確在該串內接續執行與回報。當 Claude 加入僅限管理員發言的公告頻道時，會安靜加入而不主動發送自我介紹。⟦如同進駐專案會議室的得力助手，以前跨部門開會容易認錯窗口，主管更新規定還會當場罷工；現在把手邊工作完成才套用新規則，進到公告群組也不會發出噪音打擾。⟧
body.en: Message routing and permission updates are smoother when collaborating with Claude or running routine tasks in Slack channels. In Enterprise Grid shared channels across multiple workspaces, Claude no longer erroneously reports that a workspace is unconfigured upon encountering an unconnected workspace tag. When administrators update connectors, plugins, skills, or rules mid-task, Claude avoids abrupt interruptions and instead applies changes after finishing the current task. Triggering routine tasks in threads with notes now reliably executes and reports back within the thread. When Claude joins announcement channels where only administrators can post, it joins quietly without posting an unprompted introduction. ⟦A dependable assistant assigned to a project room once misidentified department liaisons and abruptly stopped work when managers updated policies; now, it finishes current tasks before adopting new rules and enters announcement channels quietly without causing distractions.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack saying a workspace isn't set up in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces when Slack labels a message with a workspace that isn't connected
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack stopping mid-task in a channel when an admin changed the channel's connectors, plugins, skills or rules; the change now applies once Claude finishes
[Claude Tag] Fixed asking Claude in Slack to run a thread's routine now with extra notes starting a separate run that couldn't post back; the run now continues in that thread
[Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to join announcement channels, where only admins can post, without posting its intro

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 管理後台規則放寬，連接器狀態更準確
title.en: [Claude Tag] Admin Console Rules Relaxed, Connector Status Rendered Accurately

body.zh-TW: 負責在後台管理 Claude Tag 權限與連接器的管理員，現在享有更大的設定彈性。單一工作區與全組織頁面的頻道規則上限從 20 條放寬至 50 條，能設定更細緻的規範。管理頁面現在會主動列出尚未連線的 Enterprise Grid，並提供 Connect 按鈕以供直接連線。在管理設定中，存取組合的 Add a connector 對話框（加入連接器的視窗）曾在一次 Google 登入後，將所有 Google 連接器誤標為已連線；這項顯示問題已修復。⟦彷彿管理主控台擴充了配電盤容量，不僅插槽數量大增，未接通的跨區線路也有專屬開關；加入插頭的面板不再因接通一個，就把所有 Google 插頭的燈號都誤亮。⟧
body.en: Administrators managing Claude Tag permissions and connectors in the admin console now have greater configuration flexibility. The channel rule limit for individual workspaces and organization-wide pages has been raised from 20 to 50 rules, allowing more granular policies. The management page now proactively lists unconnected Enterprise Grids with a Connect button for direct linking. In admin settings, the Add a connector dialog (the modal for adding connectors) in access sets previously marked all Google connectors as connected following a single Google login; this display bug is now fixed. ⟦Envision an admin console expanding its electrical breaker capacity with substantially more slots and dedicated switches for unconnected cross-zone circuits; the plug installation panel no longer illuminates every Google indicator simply because one socket was plugged in.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed an access bundle's Add a connector dialog in Claude Tag admin settings showing every Google connector as connected after one Google sign-in
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin settings to list an Enterprise Grid that isn't connected yet, with a Connect button
[Claude Tag] Changed the limit on channel rules in Claude Tag admin settings from 20 to 50 for each workspace and for the organization-wide Slack page

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)

title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

title.zh-TW: 預設模型換上 GPT-6.1 Sol，Amazon Bedrock 支援多代理與進階推論
title.en: Default Model Upgraded to GPT-6.1 Sol, Amazon Bedrock Adds Multi-Agent and Advanced Inference Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時依賴雲端平台調度模型，現在內建與 Amazon Bedrock 目錄中的預設模型已正式換成 GPT-6.1 Sol。在 Bedrock 上搭配相容模型時，系統同步支援 multi-agent V2 與 Ultra 推論功能。同時 Bedrock Mantle 也開始接受 AWS GovCloud 區域。⟦車隊換上新的標準引擎，配套功能仍要看車款是否相容，行駛區域也有各自的適用範圍。⟧相容模型可在 Amazon Bedrock 使用 multi-agent V2 與 Ultra 推論；Bedrock Mantle 則接受 AWS GovCloud 區域。
body.en: If you rely on cloud platforms for model dispatch, the default model built into the system and the Amazon Bedrock catalog has officially switched to GPT-6.1 Sol. When paired with compatible models on Bedrock, the system simultaneously supports multi-agent V2 and Ultra inference features. At the same time, Bedrock Mantle now accepts AWS GovCloud regions. ⟦A fleet upgrades to a new standard engine, but complementary features still depend on vehicle compatibility, and driving regions also have their own applicable boundaries.⟧ Compatible models can use multi-agent V2 and Ultra inference on Amazon Bedrock, while Bedrock Mantle accepts AWS GovCloud regions.

items.original:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now the default model in the bundled and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#49318, #49339)
Amazon Bedrock supports multi-agent V2 and Ultra reasoning on compatible models; Bedrock Mantle also accepts AWS GovCloud regions. (#49345, #49813)

title.zh-TW: 從運作中的終端機工作階段登入 MCP 伺服器
title.en: Log In to MCP Servers from an Active Terminal Session

body.zh-TW:
當你需要臨時授權 AI 連接外部資料庫或服務時，可以從目前的工作階段發起登入。在運作中的終端機工作階段輸入以下指令，登入指定 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器：

```bash
/mcp login <name>
```

把 `<name>` 換成要登入的伺服器名稱。⟦如同在辦公大樓開會時，從座位旁的對講機報上要找的單位，你可以在目前的工作階段輸入指令，指定要登入哪個伺服器。⟧
body.en:
When you need to grant AI temporary access to external databases or services, you can initiate a login directly from your current session. MCP stands for Model Context Protocol (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools). Enter the following command in an active terminal session to log in to the specified MCP server:

```bash
/mcp login <name>
```

Replace `<name>` with the name of the server you want to log in to. ⟦Just like using an intercom next to your seat in an office meeting to announce which department you are visiting, you can enter a command in your active session to specify which server to log in to.⟧

items.original: Sign in to MCP servers from an active terminal session with `/mcp login <name>`. (#49290)

title.zh-TW: 語音對話自選麥克風與揚聲器，設定自動記在本機
title.en: Select Microphones and Speakers for Voice Conversations with Local Preference Storage

body.zh-TW: 戴耳機跟 AI 語音討論專案時，你現在可以自由指定聲音要從哪裡進出。這項更新讓你在語音對話中挑選專用的麥克風、揚聲器以及麥克風輸入聲道，而且所有偏好設定都會自動儲存在本機電腦上。⟦跟專業錄音室調校混音台一樣，你可以選好收音的麥克風、播放聲音的揚聲器與輸入聲道，再把這組選擇記在本機的設定簿裡。⟧下一次開啟語音通話，系統就會記住你習慣的收音與播放設備。
body.en: When discussing projects with AI using headphones, you can now freely choose where sound enters and exits. This update lets you pick dedicated microphones, speakers, and microphone input channels during voice conversations, with all preferences automatically saved to your local machine. ⟦Think of a sound engineer adjusting a mixing console in a professional recording studio: you pick the recording microphone, output speakers, and input channels, then save the setup in your local configuration book.⟧ The next time you start a voice call, the system remembers your preferred audio input and output devices.

items.original: Choose your microphone, speaker, and microphone input channels for voice conversations, with preferences saved locally. (#49437, #49836)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 改為明確啟用制，Cyber 存取方案可單輪指定
title.en: Daybreak Switches to Explicit Opt-In, Cyber Access Program Configurable per Turn

items.original:
Daybreak is opt-in through `--enable cli_daybreak` or `features.cli_daybreak=true`; `daybreak=true` alone is insufficient. By default, controls and indicators are hidden, `/daybreak` is unavailable, and automatic Cyber routing is omitted—even for saved Daybreak threads. Saved preferences remain intact. Opt-in routing requires eligible ChatGPT sign-in, the OpenAI provider, and advertised model/program support. (#49856, #49858, #49859, #49861, #51207)
Select a Cyber access program per turn with `codex exec --cyber-access-program` or the TypeScript SDK’s `cyberAccessProgram` option. The explicit exec override remains available with `cli_daybreak` disabled and leaves the saved choice unchanged. (#49939, #51207)

title.zh-TW: 提升寫入權限不波及讀取限制，啟動權限支援斷線重連
title.en: Write Permission Elevation Preserves Read Restrictions, Launch Permissions Support Reconnection

body.zh-TW: 當你核准 AI 擴大存取檔案時，系統現在能更精細地劃分安全邊界。經核准的檔案系統權限提升可以單獨放寬寫入範圍，同時嚴格維持原有的讀取拒絕與網路連線限制。背景任務也會確實繼承發起那一輪對話的既有權限。在終端機重連或開啟新工作階段（session，與 AI 對話的互動連線）時，明確指定的啟動權限會繼續維持有效，而客戶端的隱式設定也不會再意外覆寫伺服器端或已存討論串的網路搜尋設定。⟦好比向大樓物業申請特定樓層的施工許可，以前一放行往往會順便解除其他門禁，現在只會精準發放施工區的鑰匙，即使工班中途離場重新換證，原本登記好的出入規則依然一字不差。⟧
body.en: When you approve expanded file access for AI, the system now delineates security boundaries with higher precision. Approved file system permission elevations can relax write scopes independently while strictly maintaining existing read denials and network connection limits. Background tasks faithfully inherit existing permissions from the turn that spawned them. When reconnecting in a terminal or launching a new session (an interactive connection for conversing with AI), explicitly specified launch permissions remain valid, and implicit client settings no longer accidentally overwrite server-side or saved-thread web search configurations. ⟦Consider applying to building management for a construction permit on a specific floor: where approvals previously unlocked unrelated doors, the system now issues keys strictly for the work zone, and even if a crew leaves and re-badges, the registered access rules remain intact.⟧

items.original:
Approved filesystem escalation can now grant broader write access while preserving denied reads and network restrictions. Background tasks retain their originating turn’s permissions. (#49353, #49880)
Explicit launch permissions survive terminal reconnects and new sessions, while implicit client settings no longer overwrite server or saved-thread web-search settings. (#49809, #49799)

title.zh-TW: Windows 特權工作階段改用內嵌伺服器，貼上後按 Enter 能正常送出
title.en: Windows Elevated Sessions Switch to Embedded Server, Pressing Enter After Paste Submits Text Properly

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上以管理員權限操作終端機時，提升權限的工作階段現在可透過內嵌伺服器順利啟動。同時，受保護的使用者設定檔目錄下，沙箱內的 PowerShell 執行時能正確保留相對路徑。另外，當貼上偵測倒數結束後，按下 Enter 鍵會正確送出暫存緩衝區內的文字，即便在 Vim 插入模式下也能正常送出。⟦就像寄件窗口先整理好文件，再按確認送出，貼上偵測結束後，按 Enter 就能送出已暫存的文字。⟧提升權限的工作階段可啟動、受保護目錄下保留相對路徑，貼上偵測到期後 Enter 也能正常送出。
body.en: When running the terminal with administrator privileges on Windows, elevated sessions can now start smoothly via an embedded server. Meanwhile, under protected user profile directories, PowerShell running inside the sandbox correctly preserves relative paths. Additionally, once the paste detection countdown finishes, pressing Enter properly submits text stored in the staging buffer, functioning normally even in Vim insert mode. ⟦Like a shipping counter that organizes documents before pressing confirm to send, pressing Enter after paste detection expires submits the buffered text as expected.⟧ Elevated sessions can launch, relative paths are preserved under protected directories, and pressing Enter submits normally after paste detection expires.

items.original:
Elevated Windows terminal sessions can start using an embedded server, and sandboxed PowerShell preserves relative paths beneath protected user profiles. (#49855, #49690)
Enter correctly submits buffered input after paste detection expires, including in Vim insert mode. (#49810)

title.zh-TW: 討論串重啟納入最新紀錄，連線重試遵循伺服器引導
title.en: Thread Resumption Includes Latest History, Connection Retries Follow Server Guidance

body.zh-TW: 如果你重新開啟先前暫停的討論串，系統現在會完整納入最新提交的歷史紀錄。在啟動時，系統能更早偵測出可復原的 SQLite 資料庫損毀，並將受損的資料庫保留為備份檔。在網路連線方面，回應重試以及 WebSocket 轉 HTTP 備援（fallback，主要線路不通時切換的備用方案）現在會嚴格遵循伺服器的重試指示，減少伺服器過載時過早判定失敗的狀況。登入認證指引已更新說明憑證可能存放在系統金鑰庫（keyring，系統存放安全憑證的地方），不再暗示憑證一律放在 `auth.json` 中。發布舊版 alpha 或緊急修復套件時，也不會再將 npm 上的 alpha 標籤意外倒退。現在會更早偵測可復原的資料庫損毀並保留受損檔案；連線重試遵循伺服器指引，減少過載時過早失敗。
body.en: If you resume a previously paused thread, the system now fully incorporates the latest committed history. At startup, the system detects recoverable SQLite database corruption earlier and preserves the corrupted database as a backup file. For network connections, response retries and WebSocket-to-HTTP fallback (a backup option used when the primary connection is unavailable) strictly follow server retry instructions, reducing premature failure decisions during server overloads. Login authentication guidance has been updated to explain that credentials may reside in the system keyring (the system's storage for security credentials) rather than implying they always live in `auth.json`. Furthermore, publishing older alpha versions or hotfix packages no longer accidentally rolls back the alpha tag on npm. Recoverable database corruption is detected earlier with damaged files retained, and connection retries follow server guidance to minimize early failures during overloads.

items.original:
Thread resume includes the latest committed history. Startup detects recoverable SQLite corruption earlier and preserves damaged databases as backups. (#49599, #49701)
Responses retries and WebSocket-to-HTTP fallback honor server retry guidance, reducing premature failures during overload. (#49441)
Authentication guidance now accounts for keyring storage instead of implying credentials always reside in `auth.json`. (#49361)
Publishing an older alpha or hotfix no longer moves npm alpha tags backward. (#49704)

title.zh-TW: 遠端啟動 MCP 工具時保留 Windows 系統變數
title.en: Preserve Windows System Variables When Launching MCP Tools Remotely

body.zh-TW: 當你從 Unix 主機透過遠端連線指派任務給 Windows 端的執行環境，並為工具指定專屬參數時，底層不再丟失系統運作必備的關鍵設定。⟦猶如向外縣市的合作工廠調度遠端機台，以前若隨單附上自己的專案參數，容易把對方廠房原本運作必備的總電源與暫存料架設定覆蓋掉；現在指派自訂參數時，會完整保留廠房原有的運作環境。⟧現在透過遠端 stdio 通道啟動 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，即使明確指定了遠端環境變數，系統也會自動保留 Windows 執行端的 SYSTEMROOT、TEMP 與 TMP 等核心環境變數。Unix 主機因此能完整維持 Windows 執行端的原生啟動環境，確保工具不會因為找不到系統路徑或暫存目錄而啟動失敗。
body.en: When dispatching tasks from a Unix host to a Windows runtime environment over a remote connection and specifying custom parameters for tools, the underlying system no longer loses critical settings essential for system operation. ⟦Picture dispatching remote machinery at an out-of-town partner factory: previously, attaching custom project parameters to an order risked overwriting the facility's essential main power and temporary storage shelf settings; now, assigning custom parameters fully preserves the factory's original operating environment.⟧ Now when launching an MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server over remote stdio channels, the system automatically preserves core Windows environment variables such as SYSTEMROOT, TEMP, and TMP, even when remote environment variables are explicitly specified. Unix hosts can thus fully maintain the native launch environment of the Windows runtime, ensuring tools do not fail to start due to missing system paths or temporary directories.

items.original: Preserve `SYSTEMROOT`, `TEMP`, and `TMP` when launching remote stdio MCP servers with explicitly configured remote environment variables, allowing Unix hosts to retain the Windows executor's startup environment.

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集管理員上線，支援直接安裝與自訂擴充套件
title.en: Plugin Marketplace Manager Launches, with Direct Install and Custom Extensions

body.zh-TW:
想讓 AI 擁有更多新技能，現在不必手動拼湊設定檔。⟦像手機的應用程式商店，以前得自己下載安裝檔，現在逛市集下載，安裝中斷也不會留下半裝好的外掛。⟧輸入 `/plugin` 可逛官方市集、安裝本機外掛，啟用前填表設定。外掛可打包技能、規則、子代理、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與掛鉤，在特定事件觸發小程式。外掛清單秒開，Windows 安裝與移除更可靠。資訊清單可放在 `.antigravity-plugin/` 或 `.gemini-plugin/`，技能列在 `plugin.json`。透過 PLUGIN_DATA 存取各外掛的專屬資料夾，也能把命令列工具放進 bin/ 資料夾，讓代理直接按工具名稱執行。`skills/` 內的技能全部載入；遠端 MCP 伺服器填妥設定就能啟動，子代理也能用外掛自己的 MCP 工具。

```bash
# 終端機直接安裝官方外掛
agy plugin install <plugin-name>@antigravity-plugins-official
# 本機安裝：在管理員選 + Install from local directory...
# 管理已安裝外掛：安裝、移除、啟用、停用、列出清單
/plugin install
/plugin uninstall
/plugin enable
/plugin disable
/plugin list
```
body.en:
Giving your AI new skills no longer means hand-assembling config files. ⟦Think of a phone's app store: you used to hunt down installer files yourself, but now you just browse the marketplace, and even an interrupted install won't leave a half-installed plugin behind.⟧ Type `/plugin` to browse the official marketplace and install local plugins, filling in a setup form before enabling. A plugin can bundle skills, rules, subagents, MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, and hooks that trigger small programs on specific events. The plugin list opens instantly, and installing or removing on Windows is more reliable. The manifest can live in `.antigravity-plugin/` or `.gemini-plugin/`, with skills listed in `plugin.json`. Access each plugin's dedicated folder through PLUGIN_DATA, or drop command-line tools into the bin/ folder so agents can run them directly by tool name. All skills under `skills/` are loaded; remote MCP servers start once their settings are filled in, and subagents can use the plugin's own MCP tools.

```bash
# Install an official plugin directly from the terminal
agy plugin install <plugin-name>@antigravity-plugins-official
# Local install: choose + Install from local directory... in the manager
# Manage installed plugins: install, remove, enable, disable, list
/plugin install
/plugin uninstall
/plugin enable
/plugin disable
/plugin list
```

items.original:
Added `/plugin`, an interactive manager for the official Antigravity plugin marketplace: browse and install plugins that bundle skills, MCP servers, subagents, rules, and hooks, or install them from your shell without opening the CLI with `agy plugin install <plugin-name>@antigravity-plugins-official`; install one straight from a folder on your computer with `+ Install from local directory...`; fill in any settings a plugin needs in a simple form before it turns on; and manage installed plugins with `/plugin install`, `uninstall`, `enable`, `disable`, and `list`.
Added more options for plugin authors: keep the manifest in a `.antigravity-plugin/` or `.gemini-plugin/` folder, list skills in `plugin.json`, store data in a per-plugin folder available as `PLUGIN_DATA`, and ship command-line tools in a `bin/` folder that the agent can run by name.
Improved plugin installs: the plugin list opens instantly, an interrupted install never leaves a half-installed plugin behind, and installing or removing plugins on Windows is more reliable.
Improved plugin compatibility: plugins load every skill in their `skills/` folder, remote MCP servers start correctly once their settings are filled in, and a plugin's subagents can use the plugin's own MCP servers.

title.zh-TW: 跳過授權旗標不再自動核准計畫，保留人工審查確認步驟
title.en: Skip-Permissions Flag No Longer Auto-Approves Plans, Keeping the Human Review Step

body.zh-TW: 你開啟跳過授權旗標讓代理自主執行任務時，重要的規劃步驟不再被直接略過。⟦如同給了裝修師傅進出大門的通行卡，師傅進出工具間不必每次敲門，但動工前畫好的設計圖依然得等你親自簽字核准。⟧以前帶有 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 參數時，代理在 `/plan` 計畫模式下會自動放行提出的實作計畫。現在該旗標只會跳過工具呼叫的授權提示，計畫生成後會再次停下來等待你的審查。如果你希望計畫與其他產物皆自動推進，可在 `/config` 中調整 `Artifact Review` 設定。
body.en: When you turn on the skip-permissions flag to let the agent run tasks autonomously, the important planning step is no longer bypassed. ⟦It's like handing a renovation contractor a key card for the front door: they can enter the tool room without knocking each time, but the blueprint drawn before work begins still waits for your own signature.⟧ Previously, with the `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flag, the agent would automatically approve proposed implementation plans in `/plan` mode. Now the flag only skips authorization prompts for tool calls, and the agent pauses again for your review after a plan is generated. If you want plans and other artifacts to proceed automatically, adjust the `Artifact Review` setting in `/config`.

items.original: Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to stop auto-approving the agent's implementation plan in `/plan` mode: the flag now only skips tool permission prompts, so plans wait for your review again. Set `Artifact Review` in `/config` if you want plans and other artifacts to proceed automatically.

title.zh-TW: 長指令輸出減少 CPU 負擔，修復計時器空轉
title.en: Long Command Output Reduces CPU Load, Fixing a Spinning Timer

body.zh-TW: 讓代理跑耗時又大量輸出的終端機指令時，現在可減少 CPU（處理器）的負擔。⟦彷彿在等候通知時不必神經質地反覆刷新畫面，而是安靜待命並在約定時間到時準時響鈴。⟧以前代理執行輸出龐大的命令列指令時，每次有新文字進來都會重新掃描整段內容。現在只要文字已是合法的 UTF-8 編碼就不再全盤重掃，減少處理器負擔。過去代理設定帶有喚醒條件的計時器時，若條件已無法滿足，會導致單顆 CPU 核心持續維持在 100% 滿載空轉直到超時。現在計時器會在背景閒置等待，並準時在排程時間觸發。
body.en: Running time-consuming terminal commands with heavy output through the agent now puts less strain on the CPU (processor). ⟦Picture waiting for a notification without nervously refreshing the screen over and over—just standing by quietly and ringing the bell right on time when the appointed moment arrives.⟧ Previously, when the agent ran a command-line instruction with massive output, it rescanned the entire content every time new text arrived. Now, as long as the text is already valid UTF-8, it no longer rescans everything, reducing processor load. In the past, when the agent set a timer with a wake-up condition that could no longer be satisfied, a single CPU core would spin at 100% until the timeout. Now the timer idles in the background and fires exactly at its scheduled time.

items.original:
Improved CPU usage while the agent runs long shell commands with a lot of output, since output that is already valid UTF-8 is no longer rescanned in full on every update.
Fixed a timer the agent scheduled with a wake-up condition keeping a CPU core at 100% until it expired when the condition could no longer be met; the timer now waits idly and fires on schedule.

title.zh-TW: /diff 與 /resume 介面修復，修正按鍵切換與窄視窗文字裁切
title.en: /diff and /resume Interface Fixes, Correcting Key Switching and Text Clipping in Narrow Windows

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中檢視檔案差異或切換歷史對話時，鍵盤操作與畫面排版現在更加穩定順暢。⟦就像翻閱分類清楚的檔案夾，按快捷鍵就能精準翻到下一頁，標籤上的各國語言標題也不會被裁成半截。⟧以前在 `/diff` 的提交樹狀檢視中按下 `Tab`、向右鍵或向左鍵時，游標會跳到其他行，而沒有如提示說明切換檢視。現在按鍵行為已修復，且在所有 `/diff` 分頁中都能使用 `Shift+Tab` 切換回上一個檢視。過去在較窄的終端機視窗中使用 `/resume` 對話選擇器時，從「Other」分頁按下 `Enter` 匯入對話曾會導致當機，含有中日韓字元的對話標題也會在字元中途被切斷。這些介面操作與顯示問題均已修復。
body.en: Keyboard controls and layout are now more stable when viewing file diffs or switching between past conversations in the terminal. ⟦Like flipping through a well-organized folder of documents: a shortcut key takes you precisely to the next page, and the tab labels in various languages are never cut in half.⟧ Previously, pressing `Tab`, the right arrow, or the left arrow in the `/diff` commit tree view moved the cursor to another line instead of switching views as the hints described. Key behavior is now fixed, and `Shift+Tab` switches back to the previous view across all `/diff` tabs. Also, in narrower terminal windows, pressing `Enter` to import a conversation from the "Other" tab of the `/resume` conversation picker used to crash, and conversation titles containing CJK characters were cut off mid-character. These interface and display issues have all been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `Tab`, `→`, and `←` in the `/diff` Commit Tree view moving the cursor to other lines instead of switching views as the `←/→ switch view` hint says, and added `Shift+Tab` to switch to the previous view in every `/diff` tab.
Fixed the `/resume` conversation picker crashing when you pressed `Enter` to import a conversation from the `Other` tab on a narrow terminal, and conversation titles with CJK characters being cut off mid-character.

title.zh-TW: 多圖對話自動縮小圖片尺寸，避免 Claude 模型請求失敗
title.en: Multi-Image Conversations Automatically Shrink Image Size, Preventing Claude Model Request Failures

body.zh-TW: 你在對話中傳送多張截圖或讓代理讀取大量圖片時，不再因為圖片體積過大而引發錯誤。以前如果對話中累積了過多圖片，呼叫 Claude 模型時常會發生錯誤。現在無論是你附加或代理讀取的圖片，單邊上限皆由原本的 4096 像素縮小至最多 2576 像素。這樣能確保不論對話中累積多少圖片，都能穩定維持在模型的限制範圍內。
body.en: Sending multiple screenshots in a conversation or having the agent read many images no longer triggers errors from oversized images. Previously, when too many images accumulated in a conversation, calls to the Claude model often failed. Now, whether images are attached by you or read by the agent, the per-side limit has been reduced from 4096 pixels to at most 2576 pixels. This ensures that no matter how many images pile up in a conversation, they reliably stay within the model's limits.

items.original: Fixed conversations that collect many images failing on Claude models: images the agent views or you attach are now scaled down to at most 2576 pixels per side (previously 4096), keeping them within the model's limits however many images a conversation contains.

title.zh-TW: /diff 檔案比對檢視升級，跨檔跳轉與進度更清楚
title.en: /diff file comparison view upgraded, making cross-file navigation and progress clearer

body.zh-TW: 檢查 AI 修改的多個檔案時，`/diff` 畫面的跨檔案切換變得非常流暢。⟦就像使用電子書閱讀器翻閱文件，以前切換章節總會迷失段落，現在翻頁時自動對準修改處並記住捲動位置，右上角還隨時標記目前讀到第幾項變更。⟧按左右箭頭 `←` 與 `→` 切換檔案時，畫面會跳到該檔案的第一個修改區塊，並顯示區塊標頭與修改處前面的文字。每個檔案會記住游標與捲動位置，切換檔案或回到檔案清單後都不會跑位。按 `n` 或 `N` 能繼續跳到下一個或上一個檔案的變更，不再停在當前檔案的最後一處修改。頂端標頭新增靠右的 `change A/B · file X/Y`，標示游標所在的增刪區塊與檔案順序。只有一個檔案變更時省略檔案計數，終端機太窄時隱藏位置標示。底部按鍵提示移除通用的捲動與翻頁說明，視窗太窄時會換行，不再被切斷。
body.en: When inspecting multiple files modified by AI, switching between files in the `/diff` view is now much smoother. ⟦Think of turning pages on an e-reader where changing chapters used to lose your place, but now turning a page aligns right to the edits, remembers your scroll position, and marks in the top-right corner which change you are currently reading.⟧ Pressing the left and right arrows `←` and `→` to switch files jumps to the first modified chunk of that file and displays the chunk header along with the text preceding the edit. Each file remembers its cursor and scroll position so nothing shifts when switching files or returning to the file list. Pressing `n` or `N` continues jumping to the next or previous file's changes instead of stopping at the last modification in the current file. The top header adds a right-aligned `change A/B · file X/Y` indicator that marks the cursor's addition/deletion chunk and file order. When only one file changes, the file count is omitted, and the position indicator is hidden if the terminal is too narrow. Bottom key hints remove generic scrolling and paging descriptions, wrapping onto a new line when the window is too narrow so they are no longer cut off.

items.original:
Improved navigation in the `/diff` file view: `←`/`→` now open the next or previous file at its first change with the hunk header and leading context in view, each file remembers its cursor and scroll position when you switch files or go back to the file list, `n`/`N` continue into the next or previous file's changes instead of stopping at the last change in the current file, and the key-hint footer drops the generic scroll and page hints and wraps onto extra lines instead of being cut off on narrow terminals.
Improved the `/diff` file view header to show where you are: it now ends with a right-aligned `change A/B · file X/Y` position, counting the block of added or removed lines under the cursor and the file's place in the file list (`file X/Y` is left out when only one file changed, and the position is hidden on narrow terminals).

title.zh-TW: /rewind 清楚標示已清除訊息，避免選取報錯
title.en: /rewind clearly labels cleared messages to prevent selection errors

body.zh-TW: 想要在長對話中退回先前的討論進度時，歷史訊息的呈現更加明確。以前為了節省空間而清掉的舊訊息，在 `/rewind` 清單中會顯示為 `(empty message)`，一旦選取就會發生錯誤。現在這些已清理的訊息會保留原本的文字內容，以淡化樣式標註 `cleared to save space, can't rewind here`，並且無法再被選取，避免你不小心點到無法退回的段落。
body.en: When rewinding to an earlier point in a long conversation, historical messages are now displayed much more clearly. Previously, older messages cleared to save space appeared as `(empty message)` in the `/rewind` list, throwing an error if selected. These cleared messages now retain their original text content, are labeled with a dimmed `cleared to save space, can't rewind here` style, and can no longer be selected, preventing you from accidentally choosing an unrewindable section.

items.original: Fixed `/rewind` in very long conversations listing older messages as `(empty message)` and failing with an error when you picked one: messages that were cleared to save space now show their original text, dimmed and labeled `cleared to save space, can't rewind here`, and can no longer be selected.

title.zh-TW: Windows 外掛管理修復，避免檔案佔用與設定讀取失敗
title.en: Windows plugin management fixed to prevent file locking and config load failures

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上使用 `/plugin` 管理外掛時，安裝與移除流程現在更穩定。以前如果外掛的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器仍在執行，檔案操作便會失敗。現在指令列介面會在替換或刪除資料夾前先停止相關伺服器，完成後再重新啟動。要是有另一個 `agy` 工作階段、Antigravity Hub 或 `remote-control` 背景守護程序仍佔用該外掛，也會提示你關閉該程式後重試。包含 UTF-8 位元組順序標記（BOM，部分編輯器存檔時附加在檔頭、用來辨識文字編碼的特殊標記）的外掛資訊清單、`mcp_config.json` 與 `hooks.json` 檔案現在都能正常讀取。從市集安裝外掛時，也不會再意外覆寫來自其他來源的既有外掛資料夾。
body.en: When managing plugins with `/plugin` on Windows, installation and removal are now more reliable. Previously, file operations would fail if the plugin's MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server was still running. The CLI now stops the relevant servers before replacing or deleting folders, restarting them once complete. If another `agy` session, Antigravity Hub, or `remote-control` background daemon still locks the plugin, it will prompt you to close that process and retry. Plugin manifests, `mcp_config.json`, and `hooks.json` files containing a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) can now be read properly. Some editors add this marker at the beginning of a file to identify its text encoding. Installing plugins from the marketplace will also no longer accidentally overwrite existing plugin folders from other sources.

items.original: Fixed installing, reinstalling, and uninstalling plugins with `/plugin` on Windows failing while one of the plugin's MCP servers was running: the CLI now stops the plugin's MCP servers before replacing or deleting its folder and restarts them afterwards, and if another Antigravity process such as another `agy` session, the Antigravity Hub, or the `remote-control` daemon still holds the plugin open, it tells you to close it and retry. Plugin manifests, `mcp_config.json`, and `hooks.json` files saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark now load, and installing from a marketplace no longer overwrites an existing plugin folder that came from a different source.

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Agent 支援相對路徑，輕鬆引入附屬檔案
title.en: Custom agents support relative paths for easy inclusion of referenced files

body.zh-TW: 為自訂 Agent 撰寫 Markdown 設定檔時，引入附屬資源的方式變得更直覺。以前無論作為主要 Agent 或子代理（由主要 Agent 派工的輔助代理）執行，檔案內以相對路徑指定的 `skills:`、`plugins:`、`rules:`、`agents:` 與 `hooks:` 都會被忽略。現在這些設定會以該 Agent 檔案所在的目錄為基準進行解析，例如在設定中寫入 `agents: [child.md]` 就能順利呼叫 `child`，方便將相關技能與子代理打包在一起。
body.en: When writing Markdown config files for custom agents, referencing companion resources is now much more intuitive. Previously, relative paths specified in `skills:`, `plugins:`, `rules:`, `agents:`, and `hooks:` were ignored whether running as the main agent or as a subagent (a supporting agent assigned tasks by the main agent). These settings are now resolved relative to the directory containing that agent file. For example, writing `agents: [child.md]` in the configuration successfully invokes `child`, making it easy to package related skills and subagents together.

items.original: Fixed markdown custom agents ignoring `skills:`, `plugins:`, `rules:`, `agents:`, and `hooks:` entries written as paths relative to the agent's own file when the agent ran as a subagent or as the main agent; such entries now resolve against the agent's directory, so an agent that lists `agents: [child.md]` can invoke `child`.

title.zh-TW: 子代理遇錯不再誤標完成，即時顯示錯誤原因
title.en: Subagent failures no longer marked Done, showing exact error causes in real time

body.zh-TW: 派遣子代理在背景處理任務時，執行狀態的呈現更加精確。以前子代理若因額度耗盡或模型算力不足而中斷，在 `/agents` 與執行中的代理清單中仍會被誤標為 `Done`。現在遇到問題時會明確顯示 `Error:` 以及具體的出錯原因，且只要該子代理後續重新取得進展，錯誤標記便會自動清除，方便你隨時掌握背景作業的真實進度。
body.en: When delegating background tasks to subagents, execution statuses are displayed much more accurately. Previously, if a subagent stopped due to exhausted quota or insufficient model capacity, it was still incorrectly marked as `Done` in `/agents` and the active agents list. It now clearly shows `Error:` alongside the specific cause of failure whenever an issue occurs. As soon as the subagent makes further progress later, the error badge is automatically cleared, allowing you to track the actual status of background operations at all times.

items.original: Fixed subagents that stopped on an error, such as running out of quota or model capacity, being shown as `Done` in `/agents` and the list of running agents; they now show `Error:` with the reason, and the error clears once the subagent makes further progress.

title.zh-TW: /tasks 納入定時與背景工具，任務清單更完整
title.en: /tasks includes timers and background tools for a complete task list

body.zh-TW: 透過終端機追蹤各項背景工作時，任務清單現在能掌握全部作業。以前 `/tasks`、作用中任務清單以及終端機狀態列（顯示在終端機底部的狀態資訊）的任務計數，都只會記錄背景 Shell 指令。現在 AI 排程的單次計時器、循環定時工作，以及其他在背景運行的工具都會一併列出。這些任務會明確標示為 `completed` 或 `failed`，不再附帶虛構的結束代碼。
body.en: When tracking background jobs through the terminal, the task list now captures all operations. Previously, `/tasks`, the active task list, and the terminal status line (status information displayed at the bottom of the terminal) task counter only tracked background shell commands. Single-shot timers scheduled by AI, recurring scheduled jobs, and other tools running in the background are now listed as well. These tasks are clearly labeled as `completed` or `failed` without attaching fabricated exit codes.

items.original: Fixed `/tasks`, the active task list, and the status line's task count showing only background shell commands; timers and recurring jobs the agent schedules, and other tools running in the background, now appear there too and are shown as `completed` or `failed` without a made-up exit code.

title.zh-TW: 立即傳送訊息不再延遲，產物更新時立刻送達
title.en: Immediately sent messages no longer delayed, arriving instantly during artifact updates

body.zh-TW: 如果你想在 AI 回覆中途插話補充指令，訊息能更即時地送達。以前如果在 `/config` 中將 `Queued Messages` 設定為 `Send Immediately` 立即傳送，只要 AI 在該回合中建立或更新了任務清單或計畫等產物，你的輸入就會被悄悄排隊延後，直到整次回合結束前 AI 都不會看到你剛才輸入的內容。現在訊息會立刻傳遞給 AI，確保你的即時指示能馬上發揮作用。
body.en: If you want to interject instructions while the AI is replying, messages are now delivered much more promptly. Previously, when `Queued Messages` was set to `Send Immediately` in `/config`, your input was silently queued and delayed whenever the AI created or updated artifacts like task lists or plans during that turn, preventing the AI from seeing what you typed until the entire turn finished. Messages are now delivered to the AI immediately, ensuring your real-time instructions take effect right away.

items.original: Fixed messages sent with `Queued Messages` set to `Send Immediately` in `/config` being silently queued until the end of the turn whenever the agent had already written or updated an artifact, such as a task list or plan, during that turn; they now reach the agent right away.

title.zh-TW: AI 提問跳出系統通知，不再錯過待覆問題
title.en: AI questions trigger system notifications, preventing missed pending prompts

body.zh-TW: 將終端機切換到背景執行時，AI 的提問能第一時間提醒你。以前在 `/config` 開啟了 `Notifications` 通知功能，AI 停下來向你詢問問題時，終端機卻不會跳出提示，導致作業在背景乾等。現在指令列介面會像跳出工具授權提示那樣，針對待回覆的問題發出提醒通知，讓你隨時接手確認。
body.en: When running the terminal in the background, questions from the AI can now alert you immediately. Previously, even with `Notifications` enabled in `/config`, no prompt popped up in the terminal when the AI stopped to ask you a question, leaving the job waiting in the background. The CLI now emits reminder notifications for pending questions just like it does for tool approval prompts, allowing you to take over and confirm at any time.

items.original: Fixed terminal notifications not firing when the agent stops to ask you a question; with `Notifications` turned on in `/config`, the CLI now alerts you for pending questions just as it does for tool permission prompts.

title.zh-TW: /mcp 重啟服務更穩定，舊行程逾時也能重啟
title.en: /mcp restarts servers more reliably, recovering even when old processes time out

body.zh-TW: 調整外部工具連線時，重新啟動伺服器的流程變得更可靠。以前透過 `/mcp` 重新啟動 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，若舊的伺服器行程關閉耗時過久，可能會出現 `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed` 等錯誤並停留在停止狀態。現在這個問題已經修好，無論舊行程關閉耗時多久，伺服器都會順利重新啟動。
body.en: When adjusting external tool connections, restarting servers is now more dependable. Previously, restarting an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server via `/mcp` could trigger errors like `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed` and remain stopped if the old server process took too long to shut down. This issue has been fixed so that the server restarts smoothly regardless of how long the old process takes to terminate.

items.original: Fixed restarting an MCP server from `/mcp` sometimes leaving it stopped, with an error such as `Failed to stop existing instances for reload: ... signal: killed`, when the old server process took too long to exit; the server now always starts again.

title.zh-TW: 帳號驗證補上操作連結，不再誤導登出重登
title.en: Account verification adds action links, eliminating misleading logout advice

body.zh-TW: 遇到帳號狀態異常或條款限制時，錯誤訊息能提供更具體的解決途徑。以前帳號若需要驗證身分或申訴服務條款（Terms of Service）封鎖，登入錯誤有時只會顯示 `Verify your account to continue.` 卻沒有附上任何網址，甚至建議你登出再重新登入。現在畫面一律會提供驗證或申訴的連結，且在重新登入沒有幫助的情況下不再給出無效的登出建議。
body.en: When encountering abnormal account statuses or terms restrictions, error messages provide clearer resolution paths. Previously, if an account needed identity verification or needed to appeal a Terms of Service ban, login errors sometimes only showed `Verify your account to continue.` without any URL, even suggesting that you log out and log back in. The screen now consistently provides verification or appeal links and no longer suggests an unhelpful logout when re-logging in would not resolve the issue.

items.original: Fixed the sign-in error for accounts that need to verify their identity or appeal a Terms of Service block sometimes showing only `Verify your account to continue.` with no link; the verification or appeal link now always appears, and the CLI no longer suggests logging out and back in when that would not help.

title.zh-TW: GEMINI_API_KEY 連線中斷自動重試，避免回合誤中斷
title.en: Automatic retries on GEMINI_API_KEY connection drops prevent false turn cancellations

body.zh-TW: 使用自訂金鑰連線時，網路短暫斷線不再導致工作階段整次回合失敗。以前在透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 執行的工作階段中，若內部與 Gemini API 的連線不小心斷開，整次回合會直接失敗並顯示為如同被你手動取消一樣。現在指令列介面遇到內部斷線時會改為自動重試請求，不必再手動重新輸入。
body.en: When connecting with a custom key, brief network disconnects no longer cause an entire session turn to fail. Previously, in sessions running via `GEMINI_API_KEY`, if the internal connection to the Gemini API was unexpectedly interrupted, the entire turn would fail immediately and appear as though you had manually cancelled it. Now, the command-line interface automatically retries requests upon internal disconnects, so you no longer need to re-enter them manually.

items.original: Fixed `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions failing a turn as if you had cancelled it when the connection to the Gemini API was dropped internally; the CLI now retries the request instead.

title.zh-TW: 對話畫面預設精簡，思考與工具呼叫自動收攏
title.en: Compact conversation view by default, collapsing thought processes and tool calls

body.zh-TW: 當你打開終端機與 AI 對話時，眼前不再被連篇累牘的內部推導塞滿。系統將詳細程度（Verbosity，控制終端機顯示資訊多寡的選項）預設值從 high 改為 medium。現在對話檢視畫面會把相關的工具呼叫與思考過程收攏成精簡摘要，同時完整保留執行的指令與回覆內容。⟦好比翻閱會議紀錄，以前攤開來是滿紙的討論推導與喃喃自語，現在秘書預先將過程收整成條列摘要，只留下關鍵結論與執行動作，需要對帳時再翻開完整逐字稿。⟧這項調整適用於從未設定過詳細程度的人，以及過去在 high 還是預設值時選取過 high 的使用者。若你想重新看見完整的工具呼叫、指令與思考過程，隨時能在 `/config` 設定中把 Verbosity 切換回 high。
body.en: When you open the terminal to chat with the AI, your screen is no longer flooded with endless internal reasoning. The system changes the default Verbosity from high to medium. The conversation view now collapses related tool calls and thought processes into compact summaries, while fully preserving executed commands and response content. ⟦Picture reading meeting minutes where, instead of pages of sprawling deliberations and stream-of-consciousness notes, an assistant has neatly condensed the discussion into bullet points, surfacing only key conclusions and action items while keeping the verbatim transcript available if you need to check details.⟧ This change applies to users who have never configured verbosity, as well as those who selected high when high was the default. If you want to see the full tool calls, commands, and thought processes again, you can switch Verbosity back to high at any time in `/config`.

items.original: Changed the default `Verbosity` setting from `high` to `medium`, so the conversation view now groups related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries while keeping commands and responses visible. This applies to everyone who never picked a verbosity, including anyone who selected `high` while it was still the default; set `Verbosity` back to `high` in `/config` to see every tool call, command, and thought in full again.

title.zh-TW: 版本比對按鍵調整，改用上下鍵與 jk 逐行瀏覽
title.en: Diff view navigation update, using Up/Down and jk to browse line by line

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機裡用 `/diff` 檢查程式碼更動時，鍵盤操作手感現在更加直覺統一。檔案檢視畫面中的 `j` 與 `k` 鍵改為移動行游標，操作方式如同鍵盤上的上下方向鍵。這樣能完全對齊檔案清單以及 Vim（常見的終端機文字編輯器）的操作習慣，不再按一下就直接跳到上一個或下一個檔案。⟦彷彿翻閱附有頁籤的活頁文件夾，以前按上下鍵會突然抽換整份文件，現在上下翻動只在當前頁面逐行游移，切換整份文件則改用左右撥動頁籤。⟧如果想在不同檔案之間切換，改用左右方向鍵即可平順跳轉。
body.en: When inspecting code changes with `/diff` in the terminal, keyboard navigation is now more intuitive and consistent. The `j` and `k` keys in the file view now move the line cursor, behaving just like the up and down arrow keys. This aligns with the file list and standard Vim navigation habits, preventing accidental jumps to the previous or next file with a single keystroke. ⟦Think of browsing a tabbed binder where pressing the up and down keys previously swapped out the entire document, whereas now moving up and down simply navigates line by line within the current page, leaving document switching to flipping tabs left and right.⟧ To switch between different files, simply use the left and right arrow keys to jump smoothly.

items.original: Changed `j` and `k` in the `/diff` file view to move the line cursor like the up and down arrow keys, matching the file list and Vim, instead of jumping to the next or previous file; use the left and right arrow keys to switch files.

title.zh-TW: 對話畫面捲動修復，遠端連線不再前後亂跳
title.en: Conversation view scrolling fix, eliminating erratic jumps over remote connections

body.zh-TW: 當你透過觸控板或滑鼠滾輪瀏覽長篇對話時，畫面滾動變得穩定滑順。以前在 SSH（遠端連線協定）或 tmux 終端環境下，斜向滑動容易造成畫面忽前忽後跳動。現在系統會忽略對角滑動時的水平分量，並限制單次快速滾動的最大距離，徹底解決畫面抖動問題；按 `Page Up` 與 `Page Down` 鍵則依舊維持移動一整頁。
body.en: Scrolling long conversations with a trackpad or mouse wheel is now stable and smooth. Previously under SSH or tmux terminal environments, diagonal swipes could cause the screen to jump erratically back and forth. The system now ignores the horizontal component of diagonal swipes and caps the maximum distance of a single rapid scroll, completely resolving jitter issues; pressing `Page Up` and `Page Down` continues to scroll by a full page as before.

items.original: Fixed trackpad and mouse-wheel scrolling in the conversation view jumping back and forth, most noticeably over SSH or inside tmux, by ignoring the sideways part of diagonal swipes and limiting how far a single fast scroll step can move; `Page Up` and `Page Down` still move a full page.

title.zh-TW: 特殊字元路徑修復，空格與特殊符號皆能正確開啟
title.en: Special character path fixes, correctly opening files with spaces and symbols

body.zh-TW: 當專案路徑包含空格、`#`、`%` 等特殊字元，或是存放在 Windows 磁碟機時，各項命令行功能現在都能正常運作。以前在此類路徑下，CLI（終端機介面）常會解析錯誤或找不到檔案。現在不管是 `@` 檔案標註、`/codesearch` 搜尋結果，還是代理回覆裡的檔案連結，都能準確開啟目標檔案；工作區信任機制與專案專屬自訂代理，也能正確辨識在這些資料夾中透過 Antigravity 桌面應用程式建立的專案。
body.en: When project paths contain spaces, special characters such as `#` and `%`, or reside on Windows drives, all command-line features now function properly. Previously with such paths, the CLI often encountered parsing errors or failed to find files. Now, whether using `@` file mentions, `/codesearch` results, or file links in agent responses, target files open accurately; workspace trust mechanisms and project-specific custom agents also correctly recognize projects created in these folders via the Antigravity desktop application.

items.original: Fixed files and folders whose paths contain spaces, `#`, `%`, or other special characters, or that sit on a Windows drive, being mishandled across the CLI: `@` file mentions, `/codesearch` results, and file links in agent responses now open the right file, and workspace trust and project-scoped custom agents now recognize projects created in the Antigravity desktop app in such folders.

title.zh-TW: 特殊符號與中文資料夾，專案清單正確顯示原始名稱
title.en: Project list correctly displays original names for folders with special symbols and Chinese characters

body.zh-TW: 當你的專案資料夾名稱包含點號、底線、中文或表情符號（emoji）時，打開 usage 就能一眼認出它是誰。Claude Code 會把路徑裡的所有符號都換成減號 `-`。過去遇到這類專案，畫面往往只會顯示一長串編碼後的名稱，甚至直接顯示上一層資料夾的名字。若是路徑太長被 Claude Code 截短，對照也會直接失效。現在 usage 會拿編碼後的名稱回頭比對真實資料夾，就算長路徑被截短也能精準對上。⟦跟機場行李託運掛牌一樣，以前行李條碼若被縮寫成代號，地勤人員只能念出一整串編碼，現在系統會自動拿代號反查原始旅客姓名，把正確名牌亮出來。⟧
body.en: When your project folder name contains dots, underscores, Chinese characters, or emoji, you can instantly recognize it upon opening usage. Claude Code replaces all symbols in a path with hyphens `-`. In the past, the screen often showed only a long encoded name or even the parent folder's name for such projects. If a path was too long and truncated by Claude Code, the matching broke completely. Now, usage compares the encoded name back against real folders, matching them accurately even if long paths get truncated. ⟦Picture airport baggage tags: in the past, if a baggage barcode was abbreviated into a code, ground staff could only read out a long encoded string; now the system automatically cross-references the code to find the traveler's original name and display the correct luggage tag.⟧

items.original: **Project names show for folders with dots, underscores, non-English names or emoji.** Claude Code turns every symbol in a project path into `-`, so these projects showed the whole encoded string or the parent folder's name. usage now matches the encoded name against the real folders, including long paths Claude Code shortens.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式智慧判定，只在用到的額度耗盡時提醒
title.en: Quota-aware mode intelligently alerts only when the relevant quota is exhausted

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Antigravity 裡耗盡了某個模型組的額度時，切換到 Claude 執行完全無關的工作不會再被無端打斷。以前額度感知模式只要發現任一模型組用完，即使當前任務完全用不到它，Claude 也會先詢問你要不要等待。現在提醒訊息會明確說明每份額度與模型組各自獨立，只會在任務確實會動用到該額度時才發問。這項改動隨額度感知掛鉤（hook，事件發生時自動攔截並處理的小程式）升級至 1.1 版推出，電腦中已安裝的副本會在下次啟動應用程式時自動更新。⟦像在美食街各家櫃位點餐，以前只要有一家拉麵店賣光，不管你點的是漢堡還是飲料，店員都會跑來問你要不要等拉麵，現在各家櫃位分開叫號，只在你想買的餐點售完時才會確認。⟧
body.en: When you exhaust a model group's quota in Antigravity, switching to Claude for completely unrelated tasks will no longer be interrupted unnecessarily. Previously, whenever quota-aware mode detected that any model group was depleted, Claude would ask if you wanted to wait, even if the current task did not use it at all. Alert messages now clarify that each quota and model group operates independently, prompting you only when a task actually requires that quota. This update is released alongside version 1.1 of the quota-aware hook (a lightweight script triggered on specific events), and local installations will update automatically the next time the app starts. ⟦Think of ordering food across different stalls in a food court: in the past, if a ramen stall ran out of food, the staff would ask whether you wanted to wait for ramen even if you ordered a burger or drink; now each stall calls numbers independently and only checks with you when the item you want is sold out.⟧

items.original: **Quota-Aware Mode only asks about the quota a task uses.** An exhausted Antigravity model group made Claude ask whether to wait before unrelated work. The reminder now says each quota and model group is separate. Quota-Aware hook 1.1; the installed copy updates the next time you open the app.

title.zh-TW: 側邊面板對話完成通知，開頭標註所屬專案名稱
title.en: Side panel completion notifications prefix the corresponding project name

body.zh-TW: 當你桌面上一口氣開了好幾個視窗平行趕工時，螢幕角落跳出的提醒往往讓人摸不著頭緒。側邊面板跳出的工作階段完成通知，現在開頭會直接標明專案名稱。以前通知只會顯示對話已經完成，在多工處理時根本分不清是哪一個視窗跑完；現在看一眼通知標題就能立刻知道是哪個專案搞定，切換視窗不再手忙腳亂。⟦就像快遞櫃發送取件通知，以前簡訊只寫『包裹已送達』讓人分不清寄來的是哪一件，現在開頭直接標明商品名稱，一眼就能確認哪批貨到手。⟧
body.en: When working across multiple open windows in parallel on your desktop, alerts popping up in the corner of your screen can easily be confusing. Session completion notifications from the side panel now directly include the project name at the beginning. In the past, notifications only stated that a conversation had finished, making it difficult to tell which window completed during multitasking; now a single glance at the notification title tells you exactly which project is done, eliminating the hassle of switching between windows. ⟦Like parcel locker pickup notifications: previously, SMS alerts only said "Package delivered," leaving you unsure which item had arrived; now the product name is clearly labeled at the beginning, letting you instantly confirm which package is ready.⟧

items.original: **Side pane session toasts name the project.** A toast that a session finished now starts with the project name, so you can tell which window it was.

title.zh-TW: 沒裝 Claude Code，只靠桌面版也能查額度
title.en: Check your quota from the desktop app alone, no Claude Code install needed

body.zh-TW: 平常習慣直接打開桌面版軟體跟 AI 聊天，現在不用另外裝命令列工具也能隨時盯緊用量。找不到 Claude Code 的額度檔時，程式會改去讀取 Claude 桌面版的本機歷史紀錄，連 Windows 的微軟商店安裝版也支援。畫面上能直接看見工作階段與每週的使用百分比。要是本機 HTTP 快取（暫存查過資料的地方）剛好留有近期一致的回應，還會附上準確的重置時間。整趟過程不使用登入憑證，也不發送額度 API（查詢額度的介面）請求，遇到沒把握的時間絕不瞎猜，還會清楚標示資料是多久以前記下的，也會處理過期資料。⟦像在辦公桌瞄一眼牆上的出勤打卡白板，以前沒領到專屬通行證就完全看不到剩餘天數，現在直接幫你把公佈欄的現成紀錄抄過來，既不用額外跑去人資櫃檯重問，也不會偷翻你的私人抽屜。⟧
body.en: If you usually just open the desktop app to chat with the AI, you can now keep an eye on usage anytime without installing a separate command-line tool. When the program can't find Claude Code's quota file, it falls back to reading the Claude desktop app's local history, and it even supports the Microsoft Store install on Windows. The screen shows your session and weekly usage percentages directly. If the local HTTP cache (where previously fetched data is temporarily stored) happens to hold a recent matching response, it also includes the accurate reset time. The whole process uses no login credentials and sends no quota API (the interface for querying quota) requests; it never guesses at times it isn't sure about, clearly marks how long ago the data was recorded, and handles stale data. ⟦Picture glancing at the attendance whiteboard on the office wall from your desk: before, without your own access pass you couldn't see the remaining days at all, but now the existing records on the bulletin board are simply copied over for you—no extra trip to the HR counter to ask again, and no peeking into your private drawer.⟧

items.original: **Claude quota shows even with only Claude Desktop installed.** When Claude Code quota files are unavailable, usage reads Claude Desktop's local plan history, including Windows Microsoft Store installs. It shows session and weekly percentages, plus exact reset times from a matching, recent local HTTP cache response when available. No credentials or quota API requests; unknown reset times remain unknown. Includes observation age and stale-data handling.

title.zh-TW: Windows 工作列右鍵點額度標籤，立刻跳出選單
title.en: Right-click the quota label on the Windows taskbar and a menu pops up instantly

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 桌面緊盯剩餘額度時，不必特地把滑鼠移到角落找小圖示。現在只要直接在工作列的額度文字上按滑鼠右鍵，就能叫出跟系統匣（螢幕角落放背景小圖示的區域）一模一樣的功能選單。彈出的選單會自動顯示在工作列外側，不管你把工作列釘在螢幕的上下左右哪一邊都不會被遮蔽。至於原本用滑鼠左鍵點擊的習慣依然保留，按一下同樣會打開完整的額度面板。⟦宛如在電視邊框摸到快捷鍵，以前要調模式非得跑回主機面板按選單，現在隨手一按就跳出懸浮視窗，還會自動閃開邊框不擋住螢幕。⟧
body.en: When watching your remaining quota on the Windows desktop, you no longer have to move the mouse to a corner hunting for a tiny icon. Now just right-click directly on the quota text in the taskbar to summon the exact same function menu as the system tray (the area in the screen corner that holds background icons). The pop-up menu automatically appears outside the taskbar, so it never gets covered no matter which edge of the screen—top, bottom, left, or right—you pin the taskbar to. The original left-click habit is kept too: one click still opens the full quota panel. ⟦Like finding a shortcut button on the TV frame: before, switching modes meant walking back to the main unit's panel to press the menu, but now a casual press pops up a floating window that automatically moves clear of the frame so it doesn't block the screen.⟧

items.original: **On Windows, right-clicking the taskbar quota label opens the menu.** It is the same menu as the tray icon, shown outside the taskbar so it cannot cover the menu. Adapts to taskbars on any screen edge; left-click still opens the panel.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版加入新手與額度感知開關，跨工具用量一覽無遺
title.en: Windows gains newcomer and quota-aware toggles, with cross-tool usage at a glance

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上找 Claude Code 的模式開關時，現在可以直接到系統匣選單操作。系統匣選單裡的「Claude Code」子選單現在補齊了新手模式與額度感知模式這兩項開關，跟側邊面板放在同一個群組，操作體驗直接對齊 macOS。開啟額度感知模式後，系統在 Windows 上也能跨界讀取 Codex 與 Antigravity 的額度狀況，幫你一手掌握不同助理的消耗進度。⟦彷彿在多功能儀表板上裝了整合切換鈕，以前要看各家工具的用量得自己逐一開分頁對照，現在打開同一個抽屜就能直接切換模式，連其他幫手的剩餘油量也能順便讀到。⟧
body.en: When looking for Claude Code's mode switches on Windows, you can now operate them straight from the system tray menu. The "Claude Code" submenu in the system tray menu now includes both the newcomer mode and quota-aware mode toggles, grouped together with the side panel so the experience matches macOS directly. Once quota-aware mode is on, the system can also read the quota status of Codex and Antigravity across tools on Windows, helping you track the consumption progress of different assistants in one place. ⟦Think of a unified toggle added to a multi-function dashboard: before, checking each tool's usage meant opening tabs one by one to compare them yourself, but now you open a single drawer to switch modes directly, and even the remaining fuel of the other helpers gets read along the way.⟧

items.original: **Windows gets Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode switches.** They sit with the side pane under a **Claude Code** submenu in the tray menu, as on macOS. On Windows, Quota-Aware Mode now also sees Codex and Antigravity quota.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式帶你看懂專有名詞，搭配隨堂測驗加深記憶
title.en: Beginner mode explains technical terms and reinforces memory with quick quizzes
